description: She wears a deep forest-green wool-textured gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a floor-length skirt. Muted gold knotwork borders decorate the neckline, shoulder strips, cuffs, front panels and hem. Two round brooches fasten the shoulders, and a dark belt bears several circular metal fittings. A cream underdress shows through the lower front opening. A dark green-and-brown plaid wrap with knotwork edges and fringed ends drapes over her forearms. A brown leather shoe projects beneath the hem; the other foot is mostly covered.
